purpose_and_review: Full roster of 14 named provinces plus separately governed Rotuma dependency; census practice groups Rotuma with the 15-unit province table. All 15 scope units match the retained census-derived source, but official current territorial boundaries and Rotuma category need separate resolution.
Three statutory provinces Nord, Îles Loyauté and Sud; current official GeoReP source has three corresponding features but invalid polygons. Legal commune membership requires special review for Poya.

One scoped member is the wider Temotu administrative province, historically named Santa Cruz Islands Province. Official description says multiple island chains and Santa Cruz/Nendo is just its largest island; parent-geography equivalence is not established.

Full six-province tier; government describes provinces as groups of islands and Area Councils as subordinate. All six retained source units are multipolygons; exact island coverage is not independently proven.
